direction.name: 회화적인 책상 정물
direction.concept: A considered painted still life of the complete forest-green lamp, an open book and paper on a lived-in desktop. The lamp and pages share coherent gouache planes and brush description density; adult restrained illustration, not cute generic watercolor.
direction.image_grammar: Specific sharp/soft contour choices, consistent perspective, green structural planes and warm bounded illumination; the book/page edges produce a continuous winding spatial rhythm. Keep supplied lamp identity through rendering translation.
direction.body_flow: Enter through the lit book/green lamp relation, then into a substantial adjacent explanation paragraph aligned with the visible page edge. Event/date/place follows that paragraph rather than appearing in a distant corner; visit/bring-book/URL sits at the next joined still-life boundary. The title participates in the pictorial rhythm, not a separate giant heading.
direction.type: Mature low/moderate-contrast Korean serif body with enough weight and open internal spaces, proportionate Latin/dates. Precise upright small type distinct from painterly image edges; do not paint every body glyph roughly.
direction.distinctness: A unified pictorial still-life perspective and controlled brush grammar, rather than a photo-backed template or graphic light-footprint diagram.

common_constraints: Prioritize the concrete positive first-generation design and naturally connected body copy. Print full copy once in the native tool brief, no rubric or plan dump.
The current user request and exact product fixture are authoritative; implementation guidance is not an invented client-fixed coordinate/grid/font condition.
Use collected ideas; do not browse source websites or re-open studio/Canva originals for this request. Only the exact supplied lamp fixture is a mandatory viewed/native reference.
Five different whole styles; no common info panel, font or title-first layout added.
Do not read peer production or external quality feedback. Close own selection before independent evaluation.
